title: Как форма глагола меняет смысл
description: Как форма глагола меняет смысл: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Различать remember doing и remember to do
Различать stop doing и stop to do
notes: Remember doing — помнить совершённое; remember to do — не забыть выполнить действие.
Stop talking — прекратить разговор; stop to talk — остановить другое занятие, чтобы поговорить.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: I remember ___ the door: I can clearly recall turning the key.
exercises.explanation: Воспоминание о выполненном действии выражается remember locking.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: to / for.

public_payload.sentence: Please remember ___ lock the door before leaving.

exercises.editorial_answer: Please remember to lock the door before leaving.
exercises.explanation: Просьба не забыть выполнить действие использует remember to lock.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Мы остановились, чтобы проверить карту.»
exercises.editorial_answer: We stopped to check the map.
exercises.explanation: Stop to check обозначает цель остановки другого действия, не прекращение проверки.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: Remember to turning off the lights.

accepted: Remember to turn off the lights.

exercises.reference_answer: Remember to turn off the lights.
exercises.incorrect_answer: Remember to turning off the lights.
exercises.editorial_answer: Remember to turn off the lights.
exercises.explanation: В просьбе не забыть нужен инфинитив to turn.

exercises.prompt: Что означает stopped to check the map?

public_payload.passage: During a long walk, the group stopped to check the map at a junction. Later, the leader asked everyone to stop checking their phones while crossing a busy road. The two uses of stop described different relationships between actions. At the end, she reminded a volunteer to lock the equipment cupboard. He replied that he remembered locking it before departure and described where he had put the key. His reply referred to a memory of a completed action, while her reminder concerned ensuring that the task was done.

options.label: They gave up checking maps forever.
They crossed without looking at anything.
They paused the walk in order to check the map.

exercises.editorial_answer: They paused the walk in order to check the map.
exercises.explanation: To check задаёт цель остановки прогулки.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: recall — вспоминать; reminder — напоминание; pause — пауза; cease — прекращать
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: recall — вспоминать; reminder — напоминание; pause — пауза; cease — прекращать.

exercises.prompt: На что ссылался волонтёр с remembered locking?

public_payload.passage: During a long walk, the group stopped to check the map at a junction. Later, the leader asked everyone to stop checking their phones while crossing a busy road. The two uses of stop described different relationships between actions. At the end, she reminded a volunteer to lock the equipment cupboard. He replied that he remembered locking it before departure and described where he had put the key. His reply referred to a memory of a completed action, while her reminder concerned ensuring that the task was done.

options.label: An admission that he had never locked anything.
A memory of having performed the action.
A promise that he might lock it next week.

exercises.editorial_answer: A memory of having performed the action.
exercises.explanation: Locking представляет действие как уже совершённое и вспоминаемое.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: What is the difference between “stop talking” and “stop to talk”?

options.label: Both always mean ending every conversation permanently.
The first always means start talking; the second means remain silent.
The first ends talking; the second pauses another activity in order to talk.

exercises.editorial_answer: The first ends talking; the second pauses another activity in order to talk.
exercises.explanation: -ing обозначает прекращаемое действие, to-infinitive — цель остановки.

public_payload.sentence: To bring a past event back to mind is to ___ it.
